chunks: Whoever is killed defending his wealth is a martyr.

key_terms.شَهِيدٌ: a martyr; one granted the rank of shahadah

ai.seo_question: What is the status of someone killed while defending his wealth in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith states that a person killed while defending his property attains the status of a martyr. It highlights the legitimacy of protecting one’s lawful wealth and the honor attached to dying in that cause.
